We’re looking for our next Director UX Research . Could It Be You?
Questrade Financial Group (QFG) is hiring a Director to lead our UX Research team. The Director of UX Research will lead our efforts to deeply understand our customers, their behaviours, needs, and preferences. This role is crucial for driving customer-centric strategies and ensuring that the customer’s voice is at the forefront of our decision-making. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with a strong analytical background, proven track record of mixed method approaches to customer research, exceptional communication skills, ability to collaborate with product teams, and a passion for uncovering actionable insights that drive business growth and enhance customer experience. We’re on a mission to help millions of Canadians achieve their financial goals by helping them take control of their financial destiny.
Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:
About you
   • A critical thinker and creative problem solver who sees opportunities where others see obstacles
   • A customer-first strategist with a focus on long-term wins over short-term gains
   • Data-driven and intuitive, with a balanced approach to consumer insights and analytics
   • A proven leader who inspires teams to perform their best and deliver results
   • Ambitious and results-oriented, skilled at balancing perfection with fast execution
   • Obsessed with customer experience and satisfaction
   • Excited to explore new methods and tools for research and analysis
   • Proactive, positive, and aligned with Questrade’s mission and values

What You’ll Lead

   • Guide and Inspire Your Team: Manage a diverse team of mixed-methods researchers and service designers, fostering a culture of collaboration, growth, and excellence. Naturally you will inspire other team members throughout the organization.

   • Advance our Strategic Vision for UX Research: Maximize the impact of ux research on product strategy, design decisions, and getting to know our customers more deeply.

   • Evolve and Integrate our Voice of Customer Program: Define and implement a comprehensive voice of customer program that ensures customer feedback is rigorously collected, analyzed, and integrated into our product development process.

   • Lead Research Initiatives: Oversee the design, execution, and analysis of a wide range of qualitative and quantitative research initiatives, including surveys, customer interviews, co-design workshops, and market research. You will be at the centre for supporting your team in influencing and improving customer experiences by turning feedback into actionable business insights.

   • Insight Communication and Storytelling: Translate data and customer insights into compelling and memorable stories that reveal truths and inspire teams around the organization to care and take action.

   • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Product Design, Engineering, and Marketing and embed customer-centricity into every stage of our product lifecycles. Ensure that customer insights are integrated into decisions, product development, and potential marketing campaigns.

   • Champion the Customer: Advocate for our customers, ensuring their voice is heard and understood throughout the organization.

So are YOU our next Director UX Research? You are if you…
What You’ll Bring

We believe in the power of potential, not just qualifications. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every single requirement, we still want to hear from you! We value diverse skills and experiences, we encourage you to apply—let’s see what you bring to the table!

   • Mixed-Methods Expertise: You balance deep expertise in both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, with a passion for building a thriving mixed-methods practice.

   • Strong People Leadership: You have significant experience hiring, managing, mentoring, and inspiring high-performing research teams. You excel at fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented environment where researchers can thrive. You celebrate successes and provide constructive feedback to promote continuous growth.

   • Exceptional Collaboration and Communication: You have an ability to articulate rationales with confidence to diverse audiences and influence strategic decisions for delivering exceptional customer experiences. You build strong, productive relationships through clear communication, mutual respect, and a commitment to shared success.

   • Strategic Problem Solving: You are a critical thinker, able to dissect complex problems, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop innovative research strategies that align with business objectives.

   • An Open Mind to AI: You strategically and sensibly leverage AI as a tool for enhancing research methodologies, identifying novel insights, and driving innovation while maintaining a critical perspective on its application.

Additional kudos if you…
   • 8+ years of experience leading customer experience, with a track record of leading research initiatives and teams.

   • Proven track record of leading research teams within a fast-paced, large, digital product environment

   • Demonstrated experience influencing product strategy and design decisions through impactful research insights

   • Familiarity with CX tools such as (but not limited to): Qualtrics, Medallia, Amplitude, Python, Power BI, Tableau.

   • Experience with FinTech is a bonus!

Compensation Information:
   • The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

We’re looking for our next Specialist Frontend Software Developer. Could It Be You?
This is a unique opportunity to leverage your deep expertise in frontend engineering to lead technical innovation in the rapidly evolving world of cryptocurrency and new trading products, driving our technological evolution.

As a Principal Frontend Engineer specializing in Crypto and Alternative Trading Products at Questrade, you will be a technical leader shaping the future of our digital asset and alternatives offerings. You'll take ownership of the frontend architecture for our retail crypto and alternatives trading platforms, guide the expansion of our crypto capabilities, and lead the launch of new alternative trading products.

Need more details? Keep reading…
Platform Architecture & Development: Architect, design, and lead the development of robust, scalable, and secure frontend applications for Questrade's retail crypto and alternatives trading platforms, establishing best practices and technical standards.
Technical Leadership: Drive the technical strategy for expanding crypto infrastructure across various Questrade products, ensuring seamless integration, high performance, and future scalability.
New Product Launches: Lead the frontend development and launch of new crypto capabilities for clients and internal teams, from architectural design to deployment, with a focus on technical excellence and quality.
Growth Portfolio Innovation: Lead the architecture, build, and delivery of other new alternative trading products within the dedicated Growth Portfolio entity, actively identifying, vetting, and adopting emerging technologies.
Operational Excellence: Provide expert-level support for all crypto trading and transfer solutions, mentoring the team on troubleshooting complex issues and ensuring system stability and reliability.
API Integration Strategy: Define the strategy for integrating with internal and external APIs (including RESTful and WebSocket APIs), ensuring long-term maintainability and performance.
Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead and mentor a team of frontend engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and adoption of innovative development practices. Set the technical standards for the team.
Efficiency & Automation: Champion initiatives to automate workflows, optimize system performance, and enhance development pipelines to boost team efficiency and accelerate delivery cycles.
Complex Problem Solving: Own the diagnosis and resolution of the most complex technical issues, ensuring high availability and optimal performance of crypto and trading systems.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as a key technical liaison, working closely with product owners, backend architects, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into cutting-edge, scalable technical solutions.
Research & Innovation: Actively research, prototype, and champion the adoption of new trends and technologies in the blockchain and cryptocurrency space to maintain our competitive edge.
So are YOU our next Specialist Frontend Software Developer? You are if you have…
   • Expertise in Angular and React Native is desired.
   • Proven experience integrating common crypto platform vendors (hot wallets, custodians, execution management service, payment processors).
   • Deep experience in the financial services or FinTech industry.
   • Expert knowledge of security best practices in blockchain and financial applications.
   • Demonstrated experience leading the launch of new products from 0 to 1.
Experience with backend technologies (e.g., C#, Java, Go, Python, Node.js) is a strong bonus.
   • Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in frontend software development, with a proven track record of architecting and building large-scale, resilient user interfaces.
Technical Proficiency:
   • Expertise in multiple frontend web frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, VUE).
   • Extensive experience architecting and building highly interactive, responsive, and performant web and mobile applications.
   • Deep understanding and application of object-oriented programming (OOP), SOLID principles, and other software design patterns.
   • Proven experience designing and implementing microfrontend architectures.
   • Expertise in consuming and designing contracts for RESTful and WebSocket APIs.
   • Mastery of state management libraries and patterns at scale.
   • Experience leading testing strategies and implementing robust unit, integration, and performance testing practices (e.g., Jest, Mira, Cypress).
   • Working experience with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, Azure, AWS) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
System Design: Proven ability to architect complex, high-availability frontend systems with a focus on performance, security, and maintainability.
Problem-Solving Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a talent for resolving ambiguous and complex technical challenges.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical strategy to technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.
Collaboration & Leadership: A strong leader and team player who excels in a collaborative environment and has a passion for mentoring and elevating the skills of the team.
Initiative: A self-starter with a strategic mindset and a relentless drive to deliver high-quality solutions and push technological boundaries.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's degree is a plus.

Compensation Information:
   • Base salary range: $105,000 - $140,000
   • The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

We’re looking for our next Senior Manager, Growth Marketing. Could It Be You?
The Senior Manager, Growth Marketing role is critical in designing and executing top-of-funnel acquisition strategies for the future state bank entity, directly supporting our efforts to bring new banking products to the market. You'll lead the acquisition roadmap, ensuring a seamless go-to-market strategy. Responsibilities include working with agencies on best-in-class creatives, managing campaign launches, pacing, and delivery to meet KPIs, and overseeing the bank website to optimize the user journey from ad exposure to conversion. You'll also develop acquisition offer strategies, collaborating closely with the Insights & Analytics team and maintaining a holistic view of campaigns for cohesive customer experience.

Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Acquisition Strategy & Execution:
   • Develop and evolve the go-to-market acquisition strategy to ensure successful launches for our first banking products and all future feature rollouts.
   • Designs strategies for growth and full-funnel performance across all acquisition channels (i.e., SEO, search, paid media, referrals, website etc.).
   • Develops acquisitions offer strategies to generate and convert leads.
   • Define and implement a holistic strategy encompassing all paid channels for campaigns/product launches in the market, both offline and online.
   • Creates briefs and works with agencies to deliver best-in-class creatives.
   • Translate marketing and business goals into actionable media campaigns with a two-pronged focus on brand building and lead acquisition.
   • Align with the Product Marketing team on high-priority audience segments and strategize how to reach them most effectively.
   • Collaborate with Growth Media lead within each entity to ensure media best practices are managed at an enterprise level.
   • Optimize channels to maximize allocation of marketing budget and drive efficiencies.
   • Analyze campaign results across paid and organic channels and report on performance, actionable insights & learnings to all stakeholders on a timely basis.
   • Manage the Media Budget and Media Plans to support decisions around tactics and budget allocation to drive acquisition.
   • Monitor the competitive landscape, identify trends, formulate insights, and provide regular recommendations to drive continuous improvement in our acquisition efforts.
   • Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure all objectives are being met and transparency is available for all current projects.

Performance Monitoring & Optimization:
   • Defines, drives, and leverages data and analytics to optimize media performance across all acquisition channels.
   • Monitor attribution and analytics, with a focus on business KPIs.
   • Build the measurement strategy of media campaigns across relevant platforms and channels.
   • Develop tagging specifications to support media measurement and optimization strategies.

Bank Website Ownership:
   • Manage and oversee bank website, responsible for updating content and optimizing placements.
   • Identify, test and learn initiatives to drive lead generation and enhance customer experience.
   • Brief external and internal partners on technical requirements for the website

So are YOU our next Senior Manager, Growth Marketing? You are if you…
   • Have 8+ years of digital acquisition experience (platform media planning and buying experience is considered an asset)
   • Have a clear understanding of all different acquisition channels and their role within the customer journey
   • Have experience in developing strategies for paid media campaigns which are a part of bigger multi-channel initiatives
   • Have experience working with different reporting platforms (e.g. Google Analytics, Amplitude)
   • Have the ability to think strategically and drive solid results to grow the business
   • Have a strong data analytics and strategy background
   • Have the ability to identify, document and communicate insights and recommendations
   • Have hands on experience in digital marketing project management
   • Take ownership of tasks and drives projects through to completion
   • Are a reliable self-starter with attention to detail and passion for quality
   • Have strong interpersonal, problem-solving and decision-making skills
   • Have an insatiable curiosity and a constant drive to learn and improve
   • Are up to date with all emerging digital trends and issues

Additional kudos if you…
   • Have previous experience in financial services

   • Have worked on large marketing accounts with multiple LOBs
   • Have Ad Operations Skills - tagging, troubleshooting, etc.

We’re looking for our next Senior Service Designer. Could It Be You?
We’re looking for a Senior Service Designer to help us reimagine how we deliver value to our customers and colleagues. If you’re excited by complexity, motivated by real outcomes, and passionate about connecting rigorous research with meaningful design, this role is for you.
Apply through the link sending us your resume plus your portfolio that showcases your process, impact, and outcomes. We’re not just looking for polished deliverables, we want to see how you got there and achieved.

Need more details? Keep reading…
As a Senior Service Designer, you’ll lead projects that span through discovery, design, and delivery phases. You’ll bring clarity to messy problems, shape strategies grounded in evidence, and translate them into actionable improvements across digital, human, and physical touchpoints, as well as organizational structures.
You will:
   • Lead end-to-end service design projects: framing opportunities, conducting research, mapping journeys, prototyping, and influencing the shape of roadmaps.

The Opportunity: Owner of the On-Ramp

As the Product Manager for Financial Velocity Team, you will be the definitive owner of the critical infrastructure that connects a new user to their invested capital. This is an unparalleled E2E challenge that touches every single part of our business.

You will not just manage a feature; you will architect our financial velocity. You will be the sole point of accountability for reducing wait times, mitigating regulatory risk, and maximizing the speed at which new funds become available for trading; directly fueling Questrade’s massive growth.

Your success means directly accelerating the financial lives of hundreds of thousands of new investors.

Need more details? Keep reading…

What You'll Be Accountable For (The E2E Challenge)
This role requires a unique balance of user empathy and systemic thinking. You will sit at the intersection of customer needs, banking partners, and internal regulatory requirements.
   • Pioneer the Strategy: Define the strategy and roadmap for our core account funding, identifying high-leverage opportunities to drastically reduce "time to usable capital"
   • Decipher & Deliver: Translate complex regulatory, treasury, and banking requirements into definitive user stories and system specifications that Engineering can execute flawlessly.
   • The Cross-Functional LTV: Serve as the connective tissue between multiple departments - Engineering, Operations, Treasury, Risk, and Compliance, to optimize complex, multi-day internal processes into seamless, near-instant front-end user experiences.
   • Instrument the Flow: Instrument the entire capital movement pipeline, utilizing data to identify and prioritize systemic bottlenecks (technical, operational, and regulatory) that impede user velocity.
   • Drive Compliance by Design: Work proactively with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure that scaling speed is never at the expense of security or adherence to AML/KYC standards.
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year
   • You have measurably reduced the average time-to-funded-account, and increased account open to funded conversion by a double-digit percentage, directly impacting QFG's top-line revenue metrics.
   • You have successfully driven a major enhancement to a core financial service (e.g., a new instant funding method or a major flow simplification) from ideation through scalable launch.
   • You can fluently articulate the tradeoffs between user experience (speed) and regulatory safety (risk) and guide the team in making informed, data-backed decisions.
So are YOU our next Funding Product Manager? You are if you…
We prioritize demonstrated capability and passion over years of service. If you are an experienced PM, or a rising star with unparalleled impact, we want to talk to you.
The Non-Negotiables
   • Systemic Problem Solver: Proven experience managing products that integrate with complex back-end systems, APIs, or legacy infrastructure, where success depends on more than just the front-end UI.
   • Data Muscle: Hands-on proficiency with tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Looker. You can query and analyze data to find the root cause of systemic friction, not just report on post-launch metrics.
   • Cross-Functional Leadership: A track record of aligning diverse, high-stakes stakeholders (Risk, Legal, Operations, Engineering) on a single goal.
Additional kudos if you…
   • FinTech or Financial Acumen: Understanding of core financial mechanisms, such as banking transfers, payment systems, or brokerage operations.
   • You have a history of breaking down organizational silos to achieve a better customer outcome.
   • Experience managing products with high regulatory requirements (AML, KYC, Payments).
Compensation Information:
   • Base salary range: $105,000 - $140,000
   • The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

We’re looking for our next Senior Staff Product Designer. Could It Be You?
We are looking for a passionate and visionary Staff Product Designer to not just maintain our design system, but to elevate it into a strategic advantage that accelerates our entire product organization through technical design expertise and strategic systems thinking.
This is a high-impact role for a systems-thinker who is excited to build the tools that empower dozens of designers and engineers to do their best work.
As the Staff Product Designer for Design Systems, you will be the deep domain expert and a key craft leader. You will be directly responsible for the most complex and foundational design system work, owning the roadmap, driving the technical design strategy, and forging a strong partnership with engineering to build a system that is robust, scalable, and a joy to use. You will be its chief advocate, evangelizing its value and driving adoption to create a more cohesive, accessible, and beautiful experience for every Questrade customer.
The ideal candidate is a craft expert who combines deep, hands-on expertise in design systems with a proven ability to influence and coach cross-functional teams and fellow designers around a shared vision through the quality and impact of their work.
Need more details? Keep reading…
Drive the Design System Vision & Strategy
   • Define and communicate a clear, compelling vision and strategic roadmap for the AllSparks Design System, aligning it with our overall product and business goals.
   • Be the strategic IC owner of the end-to-end lifecycle of the design system, from discovery and component design to documentation, release, and ongoing maintenance.
   • Establish and govern a clear contribution and adoption model, making it easy for product teams to use the system and contribute back to it.
   • Measure and articulate the system's success, tying its adoption to measurable improvements in product quality, team efficiency, and speed-to-market.
Deliver Design & Operational Excellence
   • Lead by example as the primary, hands-on designer for the most robust and scalable components, ensuring everything we build meets the highest standards of usability, accessibility, and craft.

We’re looking for our next Treasurer. Could It Be You?
The Treasurer is responsible for managing all aspects of Questbank’s funding programs, strategic management of cash, settlement capabilities, liquidity, asset and liability management, and treasury risk management frameworks. This role is critical for ensuring the measurement and management of liquidity and interest rate risks, as well as optimizing the Company’s financial margin through effective treasury strategies. The Treasurer plays an integral role in managing structural risk and contributes to the overall financial health of Questbank.

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Treasurer is directly responsible for all aspects of asset and liability management processes, cash management , funds transfer pricing methodologies, pricing and treasury risk management frameworks. This role is accountable for structural risk management programs to ensure appropriate measurement and management of asset and liability cash flows in a manner that supports financial margin and treasury risk limits. The Treasurer is the Chair of the Asset, Liability and Capital Committee (ALCO) and Pricing Committee.

Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   • Operates independently in managing day-to-day treasury operations, including interest rate setting, hedging programs, funding programs, and regulatory reporting, while ensuring compliance with internal policies and external regulations.
   • Chairs the Asset Liability Capital Committee (ALCO).
   • Responsible for liquidity capital and interest rate risk management policies and limits , pricing and treasury optimization.
   • Chairs the Pricing Committee responsible for pricing strategies for all products including deposit sources that support funding and balance sheet management objectives.
   • Develops treasury strategies for Net Interest Margin optimization including but not limited to interest rate hedge programs, funding strategy and managing interest rate and basis risk volatility.
   • Develops and maintains a robust framework for monitoring and managing liquidity positions, including intra-day liquidity management when required, and managing the appropriate level of HQLA and investment thereof..
   • Directly oversees treasury risk management strategies and frameworks and compliance with limits, with the authority to implement and recommend corrective actions when necessary.
   • Develops and implements liquidity and interest rate stress testing programs at a level commensurate with the size and sophistication of the  growing balance sheet.
   • Establishes and oversees comprehensive cash management processes and policies.
   • Builds and manages the treasury requirement capabilities for Real Time Rail (RTR) and  direct settlement with Bank of Canada, when needed.
   • Works closely with the product teams and business development team on the structure and features of banking products, to maximize returns and manage risks.
   • Supports the development of short and long term secured and unsecured funding programs including but not limited to commercial paper,  mortgage warehouse programs and other wholesale funding sources.
   • Ensures adherence with RCM framework through effective oversight the proper implementation of policies, procedures and controls as required by regulations.

So are YOU our next Treasurer? You are if you…
   • Have a University degree in Business or Finance; an MBA, CFA and/or FRM designation is preferred.
   • Have 10+ years' management experience within a treasury function of a regulated financial institution  in progressively more responsible positions in 'like' roles.
   • Have solid operational experience in cash management and treasury.
   • Have superior knowledge and exposure in development, implementation and ongoing management of liquidity, LCFP, and stress testing.
   • Have superior knowledge and exposure to management of interest rate and foreign exchange risks and ALM.
   • Have superior knowledge and exposure to broker deposits, wholesale financial markets and securitization programs.
   • Have strong communication skills and the ability to influence
   • Have the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with varied audiences and needs
   • Have sound understanding and proficiency in risk management.
   • Have effective attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.
   • Have a high level of integrity, confidentiality and accountability.
   • Have sound analytical thinking, planning, prioritization and execution skills.
   • Have proven experience effectively executing performance management processes, employee development plans, succession planning and coaching strategies for direct reports.

We’re looking for our next Administrator, Registered Plans. Could It Be You?

The Director, Credit Risk Strategy will lead a team that leverages data and analytics to define and execute credit strategies for the full customer lifecycle. Strategy & Analytics:

   • Establish and maintain a centralized, authoritative inventory of all approved banking form templates, customer-facing communication templates, and internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

   • Act as the primary administrator for permissions within the organization’s Document Management System (DMS) and related repositories.
   • Design, implement, and manage Role-Based Access Controls (RBAC) to ensure sensitive customer data and bank information is accessible only on a "need-to-know" basis, aligning with the principle of least privilege.
   • Conduct periodic access reviews and audits to ensure permissions remain appropriate as roles change within the organization.

   • Oversee the comprehensive lifecycle of banking documents—from initial creation or capture through active use, storage, archival, and final secure destruction.

   • Manage the secure transition of documents from physical formats to legally admissible digital formats.

We’re looking for our next Manager, Fraud Risk Management. Could It Be You?
The Fraud Risk Management Team (2LOD) acts as the independent guardian of the organization’s integrity, accountable for the design, oversight, and governance of the Fraud Risk Framework across Questbank. Our mission is to safeguard the trust of our clients and ensure the firm remains resilient against evolving threats, allowing Canadians to become much more financially successful and secure.
Reporting to the Senior Manager, Fraud Risk Management. This role is responsible to support, build and strengthen Questbank’s fraud risk oversight capabilities. This role provides independent oversight, effective challenge, and governance over the business units. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that fraud risks are identified, measured, monitored, and controlled within the bank’s Risk Appetite. They will work closely with First Line of Defense (1LOD) Fraud Operations, Fraud Strategy, Product, Technology, AML, and Operational Risk to ensure the bank maintains an effective, scalable, and compliant fraud risk framework.
The ideal candidate is a fraud expert with strong analytical skills, deep understanding of fraud controls, and proven experience operating within a 3-Lines-of-Defense environment in the Canadian banking industry.

Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   • Maintaining and updating the Fraud Risk Management Policy, Standards and procedures to ensure alignment with regulatory guidance (OSFI, FCAC, etc.) and industry best practices.
   • Assisting in defining and refreshing the Fraud Risk Appetite Statement; ensuring 1LOD business units operate within these defined limits.
   • Serving as a subject matter expert (SME) during regulatory exams and internal audits regarding fraud governance.
   • Leading the execution of the annual Fraud risk assessments. Aggregating data to identify inherent risks, assess control effectiveness, and determine residual risk across the organization.
   • Conducting independent risk assessments on new products, services, or channels (New Product Risk Assessment) to ensure fraud controls are "baked in" prior to launch.
   • Reviewing and providing "effective challenge" to the First Line’s Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), ensuring they have accurately rated their fraud risks and controls, including questioning underlying assumptions, validating data accuracy, and ensuring the completeness and sustainability of proposed controls.
   • Independently reviewing and challenging 1LOD fraud strategies (i.e, rule logic, model thresholds, authentication flows).
   • Designing and executing a risk-based monitoring program to test the design and operating effectiveness of 1LOD fraud controls (i.e. verifying that KYC checks or high-value transaction reviews are actually happening).
   • Reviewing significant fraud losses or incidents to ensure the First Line has identified the true root cause and implemented sustainable remediation.
   • Defining, tracking, and reporting on Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs); overseeing the management of fraud data to enable rapid tracking of trends, detect breaches in risk appetite, and escalate findings to the Risk Committee.
   • Committee Reporting: preparing high-quality risk decks for the Operational Risk Management Committee (ORMC) or Board Risk Committee, summarizing top fraud threats, loss trends, and emerging risks.
   • Tracking and validating the closure of fraud-related issues raised by Internal Audit, Regulators, or self-identified by the business. Ensuring evidence of closure is sufficient.
   • Driving continuous improvement in the Fraud Risk Framework and governance processes to promote effectiveness and efficiency across the bank.
   • Maintaining awareness of industry and regulatory developments.
   • Leading and participating in vendor due diligence assessments related to fraud.
   • Reviewing, editing, and approving comprehensive investigative reports as per internal and regulatory guidelines.
   • Advising Senior Management of solutions, fraud issues, control weaknesses or deficiencies and trends identified during reporting/reviews.
   • Partnering with internal & external stakeholders, as well as industry peers on best practices and trends as needed.
   • Serving as a point of contact for internal teams for questions related to Fraud Risk.
   • Overseeing management of fraud data to enable rapid tracking and monitoring of trends.
   • Conducting risk assessments, investigating suspicious internal activities and collaborating with various departments to enhance internal controls.
   • Staying abreast of industry standards to ensure appropriate fraud training/education/awareness programs are being delivered to the organization as needed.

So are YOU our next Manager, Fraud Risk Management? You are if you…
   • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in business, related field or equivalent experience
   • Have 6+ years of experience in Risk Management, specifically within Fraud Risk & Operational Risk, Fraud Strategy or Internal Audit
   • Have strong knowledge of Fraud Risk Management, preferably in the banking industry
   • Have a deep understanding of the "Three Lines of Defense" model and the distinction between risk ownership (1LOD) and risk oversight (2LOD)
   • Are familiar with relevant regulatory requirements relative to operational risk
   • Have hands-on expertise with fraud controls across customer lifecycle: onboarding/KYC, authentication, digital fraud, payments fraud, credit card fraud, internal fraud, and account takeover
   • Understand how to use data analysis tools (i.e. SQL, Python) and visualization platforms (i.e. Tableau, PowerBI) to track fraud trends, challenge control effectiveness, and support KRI/KPI reporting
   • Have proven record in working closely with Senior Management across lines of business, influencing and collaboration in cross-functional teams
   • Demonstrate sound analytical thinking, planning, prioritizing, and execution skills
   • Have the ability to work effectively with internal and external partners
   • Are a proactive self-starter with a high degree of business and emotional intelligence
   • Are a proficient written and verbal communicator
   • See the big picture while being comfortable with day to day responsibilities
   • Are proficient in Google Suite products (docs, sheets, etc.)
   • Have strong presentation/deck building, facilitation skills and strong interpersonal and leadership skills

Additional kudos if you…
   • Are a Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) or Certified Financial Crime Specialist (CFCS)

   • Base salary range: $110,000 - 125,000
   • The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

We’re looking for our next Senior Fraud Investigator. Could it be you?
The Fraud Risk Management team is accountable to proactively, comprehensively combat fraud for all of Questrade Financial Group (“QFG”); to help Canadians become much more financially successful and secure.
The Senior Fraud Investigator will be required to assist in a variety of investigations such as internal  fraud, merchant fraud, merchant employee fraud, payment fraud etc. The Senior Fraud Investigator will proactively combat fraud by applying advanced investigation techniques to enhance fraud mitigation capabilities for all products and services across the organization.
Reporting to the Supervisor and/or Fraud Manager, this role is responsible for conducting an  investigative analysis on all types of fraud to identify, assess, determine and report on activity that  indicates an exposure to financial crimes to mitigate financial and/or reputational risk to QFG and our customers. The Senior Fraud Investigator will also outline key fraud risks, gaps and provide  recommendations, and drive program enhancements. Working closely with internal, external partners and clients when conducting investigations.

This position will be a 6-month contract.

Need more details? Keep reading...
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   • Developing solutions and making recommendations based on investigations and  understanding of business strategy and stakeholder needs.
   • Conducting independent analysis and assessment to resolve current investigations, identify root causes, quantify risk exposure and reduce future fraud incidents.
   • Supporting the merchant onboarding/review process by providing fraud based  recommendations to SalesOps.
   • Building effective relationships with internal / external stakeholders (e.g. law enforcement  agencies and other Financial Institutions to collaborate in investigations).
   • Integrating information from multiple sources to enable more efficient processes,  enhanced analysis and/or streamlined reporting.
   • Analyzing and assessing incidents and cases that may be complex and require knowledge on several different product lines.
   • Ability to conduct in-depth reviews and thorough link-analysis.
   • Analyzing data and information to provide insights and recommendations.
   • Monitoring and analyzing various information provided through detection systems, tools,  reports, or manually to evaluate, investigate and determine required actions.
   • Documenting actions and information found throughout the investigation to develop and  maintain account/case files.
   • Developing and maintaining an understanding of the financial crime management processes,  frameworks and techniques.
   • Providing input and developing recommendations for process and customer service  improvements.
   • Preparing reports, notifications and activity / case filings to upper management or as  required.
   • Staying abreast of financial crimes risk trends, relevant regulations and compliance  standards.
   • Supporting the collection of evidence and information to be used for multiple purposes  including incident reports/filings, loss prevention, litigation and criminal prosecution,  management information and statistics, and process improvements.
   • Exercising judgment to identify, diagnose, and solve problems.
   • Providing guidance, training and awareness to the organization (including Fraud  Investigators) to ensure they adhere to best practices and industry standards.
   • Other duties or accountabilities as needed.

The Benefits Specialist will provide day-to-day administrative support to the Total Rewards team, including processing benefits transactions and providing professional and quality customer service to employees of Questrade.

   • Contribute to a collaborative, high performing Total Rewards team
   • Perform other duties as assigned

   • Have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Benefits Specialist or in a similar HR/benefits role
   • Have at least 2 years of customer service experience, with a strong focus on delivering a positive employee experience
   • Have exceptional verbal and written communication skills; able to explain complex benefits and disability processes clearly
   • Have strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and interact effectively with employees, managers & external stakeholders
   • Have critical thinking and problem solving ability with high attention to detail, accuracy, and compliance in benefits administration
   • Are a collaborative team player who works independently with accountability for end to end processes

We’re looking for our next Manager, Corporate FP&A. Could It Be You?
The Manager, FP&A is one of the architects and owners of Questbank’s core financial planning and modeling infrastructure, responsible for the design, maintenance, and continuous development of models used for planning, forecasting, stress testing, scenario analysis and decision support.
Reporting to the Senior Manager, FP&A, the Manager, FP&A supports and manages Questbank’s corporate financial modeling infrastructure and the maintenance and consolidation of complex financial frameworks. This role is central to the selection and implementation of a new planning platform, where you will bridge the gap between legacy data and modernized EPM/ERP solutions to streamline reporting across FP&A, Treasury, Controllership, and Capital Markets.
The role will manage financial stress testing and scenario modeling to evaluate balance sheet resilience and support ICAAP, providing the executive team with the quantitative insights necessary for risk mitigation. By integrating advanced financial KPIs into a consolidated management reporting suite, this position ensures that all stakeholders—from Risk to Compliance—base their strategic decisions on a robust, stress-tested, and technologically sound financial foundation.
The role collaborates with and supports the broader QFG FP&A team in support of consolidated reporting and financial modelling.

Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   • Budgeting & Forecasting: managing the annual budgeting and rolling forecast cycles, ensuring integration with the corporate planning calendar and liaising directly with QFG Corporate FP&A to ensure model and data consistency across the enterprise.
   • Balance Sheet and Capital Planning: partnering with Treasury and Risk teams to support balance sheet optimization initiatives and forecast capital adequacy, leveraging modeling for regulatory stress tests (e.g., ICAAP-style or internal stress tests).
   • Financial Model Development and Governance: owning and continuously improving the Bank’s financial planning and forecasting models, including the driver-based forecasting engine, to support strategic objectives and provide dynamic decision support. Ensuring adherence to model risk and governance policies.
   • Executive and Board Reporting: preparing and delivering high-quality, insightful monthly financial performance reports, board reports, and other corporate financial submissions, translating complex model output into clear business narratives.
   • Continuous Improvement and Finance Transformation: key participation in the development and implementation of the finance transformation roadmap, including selection and integration of an enterprise planning platform for banking.

So are YOU our next Manager, Corporate FP&A? You are if you…
   • Hold a degree or equivalent in Finance, Data Analysis, Computer Science or a related field
   • Hold a CPA or CFA designation (or working towards one)
   • Have 3+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, with a strong focus on advanced financial model development within the financial services industry
   • Are an expert in Excel and financial modeling software (e.g., VBA, SQL, or specialized financial modeling platforms like Anaplan, Oracle EPBCS/Hyperion Planning)
   • Are an expert in Financial Modeling & Architecture with proven ability to design, maintain, and govern complex, integrated financial models (driver-based, statistical, and valuation methodologies) to support strategic decision-making and stress testing
   • Have proven ability to deliver insightful financial analysis and management reporting, and conduct various financial modeling projects
   • Have a solid record in effectively partnering with senior business and corporate leaders (Product, Treasury, Distribution, Corporate FP&A) to drive planning, manage financial performance, and influence strategic outcomes
   • Possess strong communication skills and collaborate effectively with multiple levels of leadership, both verbally and in writing
   • Are pro-active and results-driven
   • Multitask and work well under pressure, maintain strong attention to detail and prioritize work within tight deadlines
   • Pursue continuous improvement in business processes for FP&A

Compensation Information:
   • Base salary range: $110,000 - $130,000
   • The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

We’re looking for our next Senior Fraud Operations Analyst. Could It Be You?
The Senior Fraud Operations Analyst oversees the daily operations and structural components of the Fraud Operations Department, as well outlines key fraud risks, gaps and provides recommendations to drive operational and program enhancements and efficiencies, while working closely with internal, external partners and clients when conducting fraud investigations.
Reporting to the Senior Manager, Fraud Operations, the Senior Fraud Operations Analyst is crucial in supporting the successful execution of Questbank’s fraud mitigation strategy, ensuring the balance between loss reduction, regulatory compliance, and a positive customer experience. This role focuses on supporting the operational foundation of the Fraud team by mitigating fraud through actioning alerts and fraud cases. The Analyst's attention to detail and ability to facilitate operational readiness are essential to preserving the trust and confidence of all stakeholders in the Questbank’s commitment to proactively securing the enterprise against fraud.

Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Analysis and Operational Support:
   • Analyzing each case / alert and investigating, as required, through contacting the client to obtain details and reviewing client information while ensuring departmental SLAs, policies and procedures are met.
   • Assisting in the ongoing monitoring and analysis of fraud data, identifying emerging patterns, trends, and specific fraud schemes impacting the bank's products.
   • Ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of fraud case data within tracking systems to support thorough analysis and management reporting.
Backline Support Functions:
   • Participating in the drafting, updating, and organization of critical operational documentation, including fraud procedures, playbooks, process maps, and internal control narratives, ensuring alignment with approved strategies.
   • Assisting in the preparation of training and awareness materials for the Fraud team and business partners.
   • Supporting training of new Fraud Operations Analysts.
   • Gathering and organizing documentation and evidence required for internal audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory submissions related to fraud controls.
Stakeholder Coordination and Execution:
   • Coordinating operational inquiries and information exchange with external partners, such as Interac, VISA, and MasterCard, as directed by the Senior Manager.
   • Supporting the fraud management projects, executing assigned tasks related to the operational testing and implementation of new tools, systems, or process improvements, as needed.

So are YOU our next Senior Fraud Operations Analyst? You are if you…
   • Hold a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field
   • Have 3+ years of experience in fraud operations, financial crime investigation, or a highly analytical risk role within the financial services industry
   • Have strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively liaise with stakeholders at all levels, both internal and external to the organization
   • Are self-motivated, energetic, results-oriented and committed to adding value to the organization
   • Have a solid understanding of Google Suite and their functionality
   • Have strong analytical skills relating to a wide variety of banking and investment products and services, with the ability to interpret complex data and identify patterns and trends
   • Have strong understanding of fraud schemes, techniques, and emerging trends across various financial products and services
   • Have solid knowledge of the regulatory requirements related to fraud prevention and reporting, such as Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) regulations
   • Are proficient in utilizing fraud detection tools, data analytics, and risk management technologies
   • Have exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a keen attention to detail
   • Have strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives to meet deadlines while ensuring high quality of work
   • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills
   • Understand industry Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)

Additional kudos if you…
   • Hold professional certifications related to fraud prevention and investigation, such as Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE)
   • Have solid knowledge of fraud and privacy legislation in multiple provinces
   • Are Bilingual (English and French)

Compensation Information:
   • Base salary range: $70,000 - $85,000
   • The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

Questrade Financial Group (QFG), through its companies - Questrade, Inc., Questrade Wealth Management Inc., Community Trust Company, Zolo, and Flexiti Financial Inc., provides securities and foreign currency investment, professionally managed investment portfolios, mortgages, real estate services, financial services and more. Questrade uses cutting-edge technologies to develop innovative products that give customers better, more affordable ways to take control of their money.

We are everything a traditional financial institution is not. At QFG, you will be constantly moving forward, bringing the future of fintech into existence. You will be a part of a collaborative team that cares deeply about our mission and each other. Your team members will help you conquer challenges, push boundaries and discover what you are truly capable of.

At QFG, we have a culture of innovation where technology serves people—both our team and our customers. We see AI as a collaborative and transformative enabler, and we are seeking forward-thinking individuals who can effectively integrate it into their daily work. The ideal candidate will be a catalyst for change, helping us use AI to create a more efficient and rewarding employee experience while also developing cutting-edge solutions that delight and serve our customers. Join us in shaping a future where AI empowers our team to do their best work and helps us deliver unparalleled customer experiences.
This is a place where you can explore, discover and learn with continuous growth. As a diverse and inclusive place to work, with a hybrid working environment you can unleash your creativity and curiosity with no limits. If you share the same sense of infinite possibility, come shape your future at QFG.


What’s in it for you as an employee of Flexiti?
   • Health & wellbeing resources and programs
   • Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work-life balance
   • Competitive compensation and benefits packages
   • Work-life balance in a hybrid environment with at least 3 days in office
   • Career growth and development opportunities
   • Opportunities to contribute to community causes
   • Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

We’re looking for our next Managing Director, Risk & Finance. Could it be you?
Flexiti is seeking a dual-hatted growth-oriented executive to serve as the Managing Director Risk & Finance. In this pivotal strategic role, you will be responsible for safeguarding the organization’s financial health and risk profile while driving growth strategies, as we solidify our position as Canada’s leading retail Co-lender.

As the Managing Director, you will provide strategic financial leadership, execute financial strategies, and partner with both internal and external funding channels to ensure capital adequacy and liquidity planning. You will oversee Flexiti’s Finance function, including financial reporting, treasury, FP&A and will partner with corporate on transaction services and tax.

As the Managing Director, you will operate with independence to oversee the identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks across all categories, including credit, fraud, and operational risks, ensuring Flexiti operates within Questrade Financial Groups risk tolerance.

Need more details? Keep reading...
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Strategic Financial Leadership & Governance
   • Develop long term and execute short term strategies that align with the company’s vision and support business development.
   • Oversee the design and implementation of internal financial controls and ensure the integrity of robust safeguards for company assets.
   • Provide independent reporting to Executive Management on significant risks, exposures, and financial trends.
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) & Compliance
   • Serve as the owner of all Risk Management related Frameworks and Policies, ensuring they are clearly documented and understood across the organization.
   • Identify, assess, and manage financial risks, ensuring the organization operates within defined and approved risk appetite.
   • Maintain independence from business units to ensure objective control and reporting, while collaborating with senior management to embed controls throughout the organization.
   • Ensure compliance with internal operating policies as well as external legal, regulatory, and statutory requirements.
Credit, Fraud, & Operational Risk Oversight
   • Oversee the development of strategies for credit management, fraud detection, and underwriting, ensuring appropriate governance forums are in place.
   • Collaborate with Finance and Credit functions to assess exposure, reserves, and losses, including IFRS 9 expected credit losses.
   • Oversee stress testing programs and independent validation of models to ensure compliance with policy requirements.
   • Review and approve exceptions to internal management limits and promptly escalate unauthorized risk breaches.
Financial Operations & Reporting
   • Work productively with Corporate Finance on Flexiti components of consolidated IFRS financial statements, audits, and corporate accounting.
   • Manage capital adequacy, liquidity, and treasury functions, including funding strategies and debt raising as required.
   • Collaborate with Corporate Finance on financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes, providing advice and insight to business leaders.
   • Optimize financial performance balanced against risk appetite, monitoring efficiency and expense management.
Team Leadership
   • Lead, develop, and mentor high-performing Finance and Risk professionals, ensuring they have the skills and resources necessary to meet objectives and clear succession plans.
   • Ensure sufficient financial and human resources are allocated to support risk management activities and compliance requirements.
So are YOU our next Managing Director, Risk & Finance? You are, if you...
   • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, or related field. A Master’s degree (MBA) or professional designation (CPA, CFA) is highly preferred.
   • Experience: Minimum of 15+ years of experience in financial leadership and risk management, with specific 5+ years experience in a senior leadership role within a regulated financial institution or fintech lender that utilizes both internal and external funding sources.
   • Regulatory knowledge: Deep understanding of regulatory guidelines and compliance issues related to credit and fraud risk.
   • Strategic mindset: Ability to see ahead to future possibilities and translate them into breakthrough strategies for both financial growth and risk mitigation.
   • Growth mindset: High growth, high change and scale orientation with prowess for automation and AI tooling.
   • Business insight: Deep understanding of consumer financing, credit management, and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.
   • Leadership: Proven ability to mentor and develop diverse teams, including Risk Strategy, Fraud Operations, and Financial Planning.
   • Communication: Strong presentation skills with the ability to influence senior executives, conveying complex financial and risk concepts clearly.
   • Change management: Capability to establish strategic vision, drive process improvements, and support large projects for new technology implementation.

We’re looking for our next Administrator, Account Services Operations. Could It Be You?
The Administrator, Account Servicing Operations will be expected to ensure the timely and accurate processing of a wide variety of investment account onboarding and servicing requests and maintain their investment accounts, including account set-up and documentation review and validation.

The Administrator is a critical member of our Back-Office Operations team. This role is responsible for ensuring that client investment accounts flow correctly through the different stages of the account opening life cycle, ensuring proper review and processing of a wide range of documentation and deposit information. This role is also responsible for executing a range of client requests related to account administration, maintenance, and servicing. The administrator will ensure the timely, accurate, and compliant processing of documents and information, directly impacting the integrity of client records and the firm's overall service delivery.

Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   • Ensure the accurate and compliant completion of high-risk operational functions following strict internal controls. These include:
         ◦ Reviewing, validating and gathering all documentation for complex account onboardings, before submitting to Compliance for final review and approval.
         ◦ Processing a high volume of diverse client-initiated requests.
         ◦ Processing a high volume of Customer Support team requests.
         ◦ Pre-authorized deposit (PAD) agreement validations.
         ◦ Dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP) setups and updates.
         ◦ Distribution of incoming faxes to the appropriate departments.
         ◦ Validation and approval beneficiary designation requests.
         ◦ Additions and modifications to Authorized Trader designations.
   • Review incoming client paperwork and forms for completeness, accuracy, and adherence to regulatory requirements (e.g., signatures, required documentation).
   • Investigate client queries and respond accordingly while maintaining exceptional levels of client service.
   • Complete daily processing within departmental standards, and according to service level agreements, regulatory requirements and Questrade policies.
   • Collaborate with other Questrade departments as required, namely Front Office teams, to resolve complex client service issues and discrepancies.
   • Assist in creating and maintaining team policies and procedures.
   • Input and verify data in core brokerage systems and industry platforms.
   • Maintain organized electronic documentation and audit trails for all processed requests.
   • Adhere strictly to anti-money laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), and other regulatory procedures during account maintenance and servicing activities.
   • Remain current on all internal policies and industry regulations pertaining to account administration and client data privacy.
   • Other duties as assigned

So are YOU our next Administrator, Account Services Operations? You are if you…
   • College or University graduate or equivalent (preferably in administration and/or finance area).
   • 2+ years of relevant work experience in an administrative, accounting, or operations role, preferably within a regulated industry (e.g., financial services, insurance, healthcare).
   • Basic understanding of financial services compliance standards (e.g., KYC, AML).
   • A strong understanding of the investment industry is an asset.
   • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with an extraordinary attention to detail.
   • Strong critical thinking and ability to decompose complex concepts into simple and compelling messages.
   • Curious and engaged, who takes ownership of their own learning journey by asking questions and seeking out new information.
   • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively.
   • Proven experience with G-Suite or Microsoft Office, especially Excel/Google Sheets.
   • Positive attitude and strong client orientation.
   • Excellent time management and organizational skills.
   • Able to multitask, and prioritize and re-prioritize workload as needed.
   • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment.
   • Completion of Financial and/or investment certifications is highly valuable.
   • Experience using complex financial software such as Broadridge BPS  is an asset.

We’re looking for our next Content Lead, QuestMedia. Could It Be You?
QuestMedia is a modern digital newsroom launched by Questrade to replace boring financial jargon with sharp, human-centered stories that help Canadians actually understand their money and the markets.

Reporting to the Deputy Editor, the Content Lead will manage the end-to-end content lifecycle, from refining contributor pitches to overseeing the daily production of articles, newsletters, and multi-format deep dives. You will uphold uncompromising standards for precision and authority, provide developmental editing to freelancers, enforce a rigorous style guide, and manage fact-checking and compliance workflows. Beyond operational oversight, you will function as a strategic partner in planning reactionary and long-term content, serving as a reliable backup for the Deputy Editor.

Need more details? Keep reading…
This role is responsible for facilitating the content production process in a timely manner, working with external contributors, and ensuring every piece of published content is authoritative, engaging, and consistent with our voice and mission.
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   • Content strategy: Participate in strategic editorial planning, helping to develop short-form reactionary content, medium-length articles, long-form deep dives, and long-term, event-based content.
   • Freelance management: Manage the creative workflow for external contributors, including soliciting and refining pitches and providing comprehensive editing for all submissions. Regularly consult with the Deputy Editor to determine which pitches to greenlight, assisting in the curation of the editorial calendar.
   • Manage production workflows: Oversee the end-to-end content lifecycle (pitching and approval to editing and publication), maintaining a daily delivery cadence across all platforms, from shortform content to longform content. This includes producing and managing content for daily and weekly newsletters.
   • Editing: Provide developmental editing to contributors, honing story narratives and ensuring all content is authoritative, engaging, and aligned with the QuestMedia voice. Enforce adherence to our style guide for accuracy, consistent voice, and Canadian financial context.
   • Manage and oversee all fact-checking and copyediting processes to ensure uncompromising standards for accuracy, grammatical correctness, and compliance.
   • Support newsroom operations: Serve as the reliable backup for the Deputy Editor, managing key tasks to keep the newsroom running efficiently.
So are YOU our next Content Lead, QuestMedia? You are if you…
   • Have 5+ years of experience in digital media, content strategy, or journalism, preferably within the financial services or business media industry.
   • Have experience in an editorial role managing production pipelines, high-volume content, and working with contributors. Bonus: An established roster of high-calibre, reliable freelance contributors.
   • Have familiarity with investing, personal finance, and the market landscape, or at least enthusiasm to learn.
   • Have proven ability to enforce style consistency and editorial rigor across a large body of work.
   • Have strong collaborative skills, with experience working with social media, design, and internal subject-matter experts.
   • Have the ability to balance speed and accuracy when editing content that responds to real-time developments.
   • Have a bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or a related field.
Additional kudos if you…
   • Have on-camera and on-mic skills.

Compensation Information:
   • Base salary range: $90,000 - $120,000
   • The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

We’re looking for our next Content Lead, QuestMedia. Could It Be You?
QuestMedia is a modern digital newsroom launched by Questrade to replace boring financial jargon with sharp, human-centered stories that help Canadians actually understand their money and the markets.

This role is responsible for facilitating the content production process in a timely manner, working with external contributors, and ensuring every piece of published content is authoritative, engaging, and consistent with our voice and mission.

   • Manage production workflows: Oversee the end-to-end content lifecycle (pitching and approval to editing and publication), maintaining a daily delivery cadence across all platforms, from shortform content to longform content.    • Support newsroom operations: Serve as the reliable backup for the Deputy Editor, managing key tasks to keep the newsroom running efficiently.

   • Have proven ability to enforce style consistency and editorial rigor across a large body of work.
   • Have strong collaborative skills, with experience working with social media, design, and internal subject-matter experts.

We’re looking for our next Director, Capital Markets. Could It Be You?
Reporting to the Managing Director, Capital Markets, the Director is responsible for the leadership and daily oversight and execution of the Capital Markets operations. This role ensures the seamless execution, administration, and settlement of all wholesale funding programs, including Whole Loan Sales (WLS), revolving secured credit facilities (mortgages and consumer loans), and NHA MBS and CMB securitization.
The Director leads a high-performing operations team and is accountable for the integrity of asset acquisition and funding execution and investor/lender inquiries and data requests. As a key leader supporting Questbank’s launch and evolution, the incumbent will oversee the operationalization of new and existing funding channels and the implementation and administration of new securitization related technology. A key priority for this leader is the championing of Artificial Intelligence and digital transformation, ensuring the operations group leverages advanced technology to drive enterprise-wide efficiencies, reduce operational risk, and scale effectively.
Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:
1. Operational Leadership & Team Management
   • Lead and mentor the Capital Markets Operations team (including Managers and Analysts), fostering a culture of precision, accountability, and continuous improvement.
   • Oversee the daily administration of all funding programs, ensuring all operational milestones (pooling, sales, remittances, and settlements) are met without fail.
   • Manage the operational budget and resource allocation to support the bank’s growth, including the onboarding of new technology and headcount for NHAMBS administration.
2. Transaction Execution & Program Administration
   • Quarterback the execution of ongoing Whole Loan Sales and issuance of Multi-family MBS pools.
   • Reconcile collections and ensure accuracy in P&I ITF account, timely MBS remittances, and compliant excess spread clearing.
   • Oversee and manage the revolving credit facilities and collateral management activities, including eligibility testing, concentration limits, covenant monitoring and forecasting,  and the preparation of draw documentation.
   • Manage interest rate hedging and swap payment reconciliations required for the funding facilities
3. Stakeholder Management & Inquiry Resolution
   • Act as the primary operational point of contact for external stakeholders, including ABCP lenders, Whole Loan buyers, CMHC, Custodians, and Rating Agencies.
   • Facilitate and resolve complex internal/external inquiries regarding portfolio performance, remittance discrepancies, and/or contractual obligations.
   • Partner with Treasury, Cash Management, Credit Risk and Servicing teams to optimize the allocation, pooling, and sales process across the enterprise.
4. Governance, Audit & Data Integrity
   • Serve as the operational lead for internal and external audits (e.g., Protiviti, CMHC, investors/lenders).
   • Ensure all data requests and regulatory reporting (including NHA MBS administration via MortgageHub) are delivered with 100% accuracy and within strict timelines.
   • Support the onboarding of new technology and systems by leading the operational testing and implementation of Capital Markets capabilities.

So are YOU our next Director, Capital Markets? You are if you…
   • Have 10+ years of experience in Capital Markets operations, Securitization, or Treasury operations within a Financial Institution.
   • Have expert-level knowledge of NHA MBS and CMB, Revolving Credit Facilities, and Whole Loan Sale mechanics.
   • Have strong leadership skills with a proven track record of managing operational teams through periods of significant organizational change or rapid growth.
   • Have experience with securitization platforms (e.g., MortgageHub).
   • Have operational resilience and the ability to manage high-volume, time-sensitive transaction cycles with zero tolerance for error.
   • Have strategic problem solving skills and can translate complex program structures into repeatable, scalable operational processes.
   • Have strong influencing skills and the ability to navigate and influence cross-functional teams (Legal, Risk, Tech, Finance) to drive operational outcomes.
Additional kudos if you…
   • Have experience in Multi-family mortgage securitization and aggregator relationship management.
   • Have a deep understanding of OSFI Guidelines including B20, LAR & CAR Guidelines.
   • Have a professional designation (CFA, FRM, CPA, or MBA).
